title: Attackers Target Developer Credentials to Expand Supply Chain Intrusions Beyond Source Code
content_md: Software supply chain attacks are increasingly evolving into cloud identity breaches, as attackers weaponize trusted packages to steal credentials from developer workstations and CI/CD environments before an application is ever executed.
